snippet.title: Pastor Miqueias Gomes | Escritor | Líder Cristão
snippet.description:
PASTOR MIQUEIAS GOMES | MINISTRO DO EVANGELHO, ESCRITOR E LÍDER CRISTÃO
O Pastor Miqueias Gomes é ministro do Evangelho, pregador da Palavra de Deus desde os 14 anos de idade, escritor e líder cristão. Sua trajetória é marcada pela dedicação ao ministério pastoral, pelo compromisso com as Escrituras Sagradas e pela missão de anunciar o Evangelho de Jesus Cristo.
Ordenado e consagrado ao ministério pastoral em 2004. É casado com Nali Gomes, que exerce o ministério como pastora auxiliar ao seu lado. Juntos, são pais de duas filhas: Anna Paula e Emily Dayanne. A família ocupa um lugar especial em sua caminhada pessoal e ministerial.
Como escritor, busca transmitir ensinamentos bíblicos e experiências de vida que contribuam para a edificação espiritual e o fortalecimento das famílias.
Sua missão é servir a Deus, proclamar a verdade das Escrituras e contribuir para a transformação de vidas.
REVIVAL CHURCH — IGREJA DO AVIVAMENTO
📍 161 Border St, East Boston, MA 02128, Estados Unidos 🇺🇸

snippet.title: The Odd Encyclopedia
snippet.description:
Odd Encyclopedia: the strange, surprising, and hidden facts behind everyday things.

snippet.title: Dana Love, PhD
snippet.description:
I'm Dana Love. I've been an economist, a builder, and an investor in crypto since 2011. I served as CTO on Layer 1 chains, as CEO of a crypto payments company, and as a core contributor to Layer 1 and Layer 2 protocols. I advised dozens of projects. I made and lost six, seven, and eight-figure fortunes across six market cycles from dot-com through crypto and AI.

In 2026, I published The Token Trap. It hit #1 on Amazon in Bitcoin & Cryptocurrencies, Money & Monetary Policy, and Online Banking. I explain why crypto didn't fail, and how they took advantage of you. It also educates on how that pattern repeated in the past and how it will repeat in the future.

That's what I do here. If you want to succeed in technology investing, you need to know the real rules of the game. I share my experience as an insider, an academic, and an entrepreneur who has learned and built for 30+ years.

snippet.title: ArtTactic
snippet.description: An insider's view to the art market, ArtTactic is an art market research firm based in London set up by Anders Petterson in 2001. The company uses techniques similar to those used in the financial markets to analyse the art market and build up art market trends. Their services include market sector reports for both art mediums such as photography and regional sectors such as China, auction analysis, artist reports, and the ArtTactic confidence reports, which are surveys of the leading art market players and what their sentiments and confidence for the art markets are. There are confidence reports for US, European, Chinese and Indian markets
